historical_claims.anchor: Yossarian flies combat missions over enemy territory.
The rule pretends to offer an exit, and the act of trying to use the exit closes it.
He arranges for the bombing of his own base as a business transaction.
Doc Daneeka's name is recorded on that flight's list, although he was not actually aboard.
Yossarian returns to Rome later and finds it transformed into a place of menace.
Then he learns something about Orr.

description: Examines Yossarian’s wartime predicament through contradictory regulations, bureaucracy, commerce, dark comedy, and the struggle to survive. Covers The island and its rules; Officers who compete, officers who profit; Missions that refuse to end; The secret of Snowden.
